question: Where, and through which mechanism, does the Q24 host lose its 9.12e-8: which layers and units carry the error, where is it born rather than propagated, and which of the newly exported source-uncertainty observables predict its birth sites?
scope: Read-only analysis. No host source is modified, no model is trained, no gradient is taken, no meter runs, no deployment claim is made. Truth is the lawful observer_fit target set already used by every closed development experiment.

development_frame.uncertainty_channels: public_aug7_source_observable_tape_v1 rows (7 channels; note these describe the cp1792 development host, retained as a cross-frame comparison only)

native_frame.targets: data_gate/sealed_role_target_bundle/observer_fit.parquet rows 35..234 (lawful, previously opened by the pilot protocol)
native_frame.uncertainty_channels: public_native_r10_source_uncertainty_pilot_v1 rows (10 channels describing the actual Q24 host)

frozen_metrics.name: layer_error_profile
frozen_metrics.definition: Per-layer host MSE and its increment Delta_l = mse_l - mse_(l-1) over each frame's population; fractional share of final-layer MSE reached by each layer.

frozen_metrics.name: unit_concentration
frozen_metrics.definition: Per-frame, per-layer Gini-style concentration: fraction of the layer's squared error carried by the top 1% and top 10% of units, plus cross-row persistence (Pearson correlation of per-unit squared-error profiles between disjoint row halves split by even/odd role rank).

frozen_metrics.name: birth_attribution
frozen_metrics.definition: Per layer, regress e_l on the exact linear propagation of e_(l-1): fit the scalar a_l minimizing ||e_l - a_l * Phi_l (e_(l-1) @ W_l)||^2 over units and rows per frame (Phi_l = native/dev tape channel 5 gate), and report the born fraction b_l = ||e_l - a_l * Phi_l (e_(l-1) @ W_l)||^2 / ||e_l||^2. Weights come from the sealed feature store; this is descriptive attribution, not a model claim.

frozen_metrics.name: mechanism_correlation
frozen_metrics.definition: For each uncertainty channel c and layer l: Pearson correlation over units and rows between |channel value| and (i) the local squared error e_l^2 and (ii) the born-error square from M3; reported per layer and pooled over layers 2..15, in each frame.

frozen_metrics.name: row_level_prediction
frozen_metrics.definition: Per frame: Pearson correlation over rows between final-layer host MSE and each channel's row-mean absolute magnitude, plus the same for the M3 born-error total.

frozen_metrics.name: hard_row_mechanics
frozen_metrics.definition: For the four development hard rows (201, 310, 599, 643): their layer profiles, unit concentration, and channel magnitudes versus population medians.

conclusion_rule: The dominant mechanism claim must cite the largest pooled M4(ii) correlation with at least 0.15 absolute magnitude and consistency of sign across at least 10 of 14 corrected layers; if no channel reaches that bar, the receipt must state that no exported observable localizes the born error and the proposal must be justified from M1-M3 structure alone.
proposal_rule: Exactly one graph-ready targeted host-improvement proposal, design-only, with a mechanism, an implementation sketch in host source terms, a conservative cost statement against the 65-66e9 FLOP headroom under 2^41, and explicit conformance to the closed cap-ladder (no rank raises), partial-fix (bit-exact or joint-retune or clean-slate), and co-adaptation laws.
